title: Your Birthday Too
style_prompt: bittersweet acoustic pop love song with a Spanish guitar heart, 90 BPM, D major, one repeating four-chord loop Bm - G - D - A, one chord per bar, the same loop all the way through, fingerpicked nylon-string Spanish guitar up front, soft rumba-flamenca strumming on the choruses, tasteful Spanish guitar fills between vocal lines, cajon, palmas handclaps, upright bass, warm emotional male tenor, close and breathy in the verses, aching and open in the chorus, gentle falsetto lifts, strong unforgettable vocal melody that lingers sweetly on the major third, big singable chorus hook, warm natural room sound, nostalgic and tender, quiet opening that builds to a full-hearted chorus
negative_style: harsh synths, distorted guitars, aggressive drums, autotune artifacts, lo-fi, rap verse, key change, abrupt chord changes, EDM drop

sections.name: Intro
sections.style_notes: solo nylon Spanish guitar, slow and tender, lots of space

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Five a.m., the sea at Hua Hin like glass
We'd swim out before the town woke up
A fresh fish from the market in a plastic bag
We'd eat it at the condo, and that was enough
sections.style_notes: voice and one guitar only, intimate, no percussion

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: We were fire and fire, we could burn the whole night down
Then water, the calmest sea around

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the markets, and the five a.m. blue
And every year they light the candles, and I think of you
'Cause it's your birthday too
It's your birthday too
sections.style_notes: rumba strumming, palmas, upright bass, harmonies join, full-hearted

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Drunk at the bar at the end of our street
Something from a food stall, too late to eat
Back home you'd put Faded on, we'd sing along
And pass out halfway through the song
sections.style_notes: lighter groove, playful, guitar fills answer the vocal

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: We built a house, it's yours now, and that's right
I left, and it's the hardest thing I've done in my life
I've been married since, and I'll tell you something true
I don't think of her the way I think of you
sections.style_notes: groove drops to guitar and soft cajon, confessional

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: We were fire and fire, I can still feel the heat
Then water, that's the part I keep

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the markets, and the five a.m. blue
And every year they light the candles, and I think of you
'Cause it's your birthday too
It's your birthday too

sections.name: Bridge
lines: I'm in Australia now, I built a life, I'm fine
I'm not asking for you back, I'm not rewriting time
I just want you to know, wherever you are
You're the most alive I've ever been, by far
sections.style_notes: everything drops out, one guitar and one voice, the quietest and most honest moment

sections.name: Final Chorus
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the markets, and the five a.m. blue
And every year they light the candles, and I think of you
'Cause it's your birthday too

'Cause it's your birthday too
It's your birthday too
sections.style_notes: biggest moment, full band, passionate ad-libs, Spanish guitar soaring

sections.name: Outro
lines: Happy birthday to you
And me
sections.style_notes: solo guitar again, almost whispered, slow fade
